# LSet <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LSet:String string:String, size:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |
| `size` | In | Int32 | required | The length of the result. |

**Returns:** A string of exactly `size` characters.

## Description

Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by cutting it off or padding it with spaces on the right, so the text stays on the left. Useful for columns.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + LSet$("ab", 5) + "]"
Print "[" + LSet$("abcdef", 3) + "]"
```

```text
[ab   ]
[abc]
```
